authority: Live yazi 26.5.6 driven on a real PTY reproducing the Glass VT capability envelope (TIOCSWINSZ with pixel geometry, raw line discipline, xterm.js-shaped query replies).
finding: The Engine Room rendered no image at all. CommandBuilder seeds the PTY from the parent environment and apply_glass_vt_profile stripped only TERM_PROGRAM/TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION, so GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR survived. Yazi resolved the host emulator from that marker, skipped negotiating with the Glass renderer, and selected an adapter for a terminal that was not drawing the pixels — chafa, which is not installed on this host.
fix: HOST_TERMINAL_IDENTITY_VARS in src-tauri/src/lib.rs now strips the full host-identity set, and the renderer answers the pixel-geometry queries via windowOptions.

before_fix.emulator_detect: Emulator { kind: Left(Ghostty), version: "xterm(6.1.0)", light: false, csi_16t: (10, 20), force_16t: false }

after_fix.emulator_detect: Emulator { kind: Right(Unknown { kgp: false, sixel: true }), version: "xterm(6.1.0)", light: false, csi_16t: (10, 20), force_16t: false }

notes: sixel:true is negotiated from the renderer's own DA1 reply — @xterm/addon-image answers CSI ?62;4;9;22c when sixelSupport is enabled. No host impersonation is involved.
csi_16t:(10,20) is only populated because windowOptions.getCellSizePixels answers CSI 16 t. Unanswered, Yazi prints 'Terminal response timeout' and images have no scale reference.

YAZI_IMAGE_PROTOCOL is still exported for image-protocol-aware consumers, but yazi 26.5.6 does not read it — the only YAZI_* variables it reads are YAZI_CONFIG_HOME, YAZI_FILE_ONE, YAZI_ID, YAZI_LEVEL, YAZI_LOG, YAZI_PID and YAZI_ZOXIDE_OPTS. It is not the authority for adapter selection.

Kitty graphics support is retained end to end (addon kittySupport plus the U+10EEEE placeholder adapter). Yazi 26.5.6 sets kgp:true only from a known emulator brand; it emits the a=q capability probe but answering it with i=31;OK did not flip kgp in testing, so Kgp-by-negotiation is NOT claimed here.
